General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
These are the Suzuki OEM Soft-top Frame Bow Cushions. They are made from nitrocellulose foam covered in black vinyl with a peel-off adhesive back.
It wraps around and adheres to the frame bow to protect the soft-top and give an attractive appearance.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 3 – Soft-top Frame Bow Cushions
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
